items.item: Important finding at CLAUDE.md:12: The diff adds the Windows-only runtime dependency `tzdata` and makes `pip install -e .` the working install, so CLAUDE.md's Setup line (`python -m pip install pytest ruff polars`, 'the one runtime dependency is `polars>=1.0`') is now outdated and on Windows no longer gives a passing suite; a run may not edit it, and plan.md names the replacement lines for the owner, who must merge them after this change reaches main. [REVIEW.md Framework rules: flag when the change has made CLAUDE.md outdated]
